source.group_definition: Original Cresci collection categories plus one Gilani collection, prefixed by dataset
source.limitations: Proxy collection shift, not verified campaign shift. Cresci 2015/2017 collections overlap historically; all duplicated sampled account IDs removed, but category dependence remains. Gilani has no temporal events, so event availability is confounded with collection. Few independent human collection units imply weak statistical power. No chronological profile history.
